applicableAreas: Site Data Table on Site Plan sheet
findings.comment: The Site Data Table does not use separate columns or structural sections to distinguish existing conditions from proposed conditions. Instead, data is presented in a single-column layout using distinct row labels (e.g., 'Existing Impervious Cover' vs. 'Total Impervious Cover'). A clear, side-by-side column format showing existing and proposed conditions separately is required.

applicableAreas: Site Data Table on Site Plan sheet
findings.comment: The Site Data Table does not provide an explicit 'Total' or 'Combined' column showing combined existing plus proposed values. While some rows show existing and proposed separately, there is no unified summary row totaling existing and proposed conditions together.

applicableAreas: Site Data Table on Site Plan sheet
findings.comment: The Site Data Table does not show the number of residential units proposed. While unit count (39) appears in the Site Area Calculation table and Building Data Table, the primary Site Data Table does not include this required field.

applicableAreas: Site Data Table on Site Plan sheet
findings.comment: The Site Data Table does not show units per acre, either permitted or proposed. This metric is required for residential developments to demonstrate compliance with density limits in the Site Development Regulations Table.

applicableAreas: Building Data Table on Site Plan sheet
findings.comment: The Building Data Table shows building coverage in square feet only and does not include percentage values for each building. Building coverage must be shown in both square feet and percentage format per building.

applicableAreas: Building Data Table on Site Plan sheet
findings.comment: The Building Data Table does not show building height in the required format. While a separate Building Height Table shows height in feet, the Building Data Table is missing heights listed in both stories and feet. Additionally, maximum allowed height for the zoning district is not shown in the Building Data Table.

applicableAreas: Building Data Table on Site Plan sheet
findings.comment: The Building Data Table does not show finished floor elevation (FFE) for any building. Per Fire Prevention Code requirements, FFE must be documented for each building in the Building Data Table.

applicableAreas: Building Data Table on Site Plan sheet
findings.comment: Foundation type is shown only as a project-wide note ('Slab on Grade') rather than per building in the Building Data Table. Foundation type must be documented individually for each building.

applicableAreas: Building Data Table on Site Plan sheet
findings.comment: The Building Data Table does not include a totals row summing all numeric values (GFA, building coverage, and building height) across all eight buildings. While individual totals exist in the Site Data Table, the Building Data Table must include its own summary totals row.

applicableAreas: Site Data Table, Cover Sheet, Survey Data
findings.comment: The Site Data Table values are not consistent with or verified against survey data. The site plan claims a gross site area of 2.16 acres (94,192 sf), while Travis County Appraisal District records show 2.1970 acres (95,701 sf). This discrepancy of approximately 1,509 sf must be reconciled and verified against the controlling survey.

applicableAreas: Site Data Table, Building Data Table, Application documents
findings.comment: Building coverage and impervious cover values are inconsistent across documents. The site plan shows 59% impervious cover, the application shows 59.5% proposed impervious cover, and the engineer's summary letter states 60% proposed impervious cover. These values must be reconciled and made consistent.

Gross site area values are inconsistent across the plan set. The Cover Sheet states 2.16 acres while the Site Plan shows 2.162 acres (94,192 sf). Although the difference is small, these values must be unified and consistently applied throughout all plan sheets.

The gross site area of 2.16 acres (94,192 sf) shown in the Site Data Table has not been reconciled with Travis County Appraisal District (TCAD) records, which show 2.1970 acres (95,701 sf). Documentation of reconciliation or explanation of the discrepancy is required.

applicableAreas: Site Data Table, Building Data Table
findings.comment: Unit types and counts are not broken out in the Site Data Table or a dedicated unit type table on the site plan. While unit counts by type (16 Two Bedroom, 23 Three Bedroom) appear in supporting tables, the required unit type count table must be prominently displayed on the site plan showing studio/efficiency, 1 bedroom, 2 bedroom, 3 bedroom, and total units.

applicableAreas: Site Data Table, Building Data Table
findings.comment: Square footage per unit type is not shown in the Site Data Table or Building Data Table. While the Site Area Calculation table shows required site area per unit type, gross floor area per unit type must also be documented.

Site area available per unit is not shown in the Site Data Table. The SDT must display total site area divided by total number of units to demonstrate adequate site area per dwelling unit (94,192 sf ÷ 39 units = 2,416 sf/unit).

applicableAreas: Site Data Table, Building Data Table, Benchmarking Application
findings.comment: Gross floor area consistency cannot be fully verified. GFA is consistent between the Site Data Table (83,986 sf) and Building Data Table (sum = 83,986 sf), but verification against the Water Benchmarking Certificate/Application cannot be completed without access to that document.

Q2 impervious cover table is not present in the submitted site plan set. Verification of Q2 table notes clarifying deductions from gross site area, slopes designation, and historical ordinance references cannot be completed. Determine if Q2 table is required and provide if applicable.

Water Benchmarking Certificate/Application scope cannot be verified. The Water Benchmarking Application is not included in the available site plan documents, so it cannot be confirmed that GFA values represent the total site area rather than only the redevelopment area for project classification purposes under LDC § 25-9-411(3).
